title: Dominated convergence, Cauchy form: a series bounded by a Cauchy series is Cauchy
statement: forall f g, (forall k, le (abs (f k)) (g k)) -> Cauchy (sumRange g) -> Cauchy (sumRange f) -- the comparison test's Cauchy half. Eliminates the Cauchy witness's existential on the hypothesis, splits forall m n via the DECIDABLE Nat.le_total (never branching on the undecidable CReal.le itself), and in each branch instantiates the ordered-pair normalized bound at whichever of (m,n)/(n,m) satisfies its own a<=b side condition.
